CPI MP Alleges Journalist Harassment, Writes to Home Minister

Communist Party of India (CPI) Member of Parliament (MP) Sandosh Kumar has written to Union Home Minister Amit Shah alleging harassment and unlawful confinement of journalists. The journalists were reportedly covering protests against the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). Kumar has requested Shah to initiate a probe into the alleged incidents.
